_readme: All heroines, their play styles, outfit layers and story. Edit freely: the game reads this file at start. Stats: speed = paddle top speed (px/s), size = paddle radius (px), reaction = seconds she sees the puck late (higher is easier), aim = how far her aim wanders (px), bank = 0..1 how often she banks shots, aggression = 0..1 how far forward she plays. Layer effects: speed/size multiply, reaction adds. attitude = what she thinks of you after N wins (0..4). barks = lines she says during a match: 'hostile' for her first two matches, 'warm' for the last two. Every character is an adult.

prologue.text: The Afterglow: a neon arcade lounge that stays open past three. Last month a bar chain bought it. Tonight they sent their new night manager.
That's you. Your first memo from head office says to shut down the regulars' after-hours game.
So YOU'RE the suit. You towed my bike this morning, by the way.
It was in the fire lane.
And you got the manager job I've been doing for free for two years. Congratulations. Everyone hates you.
Here's the deal. The Last Call League has rules, and everyone on the whiteboard signed them. First to five on the table. Score a power smash and the other player loses a layer.
Beat us at our own game and maybe the league lets you stay. Lose, and you write head office a letter saying you quit.
Win them over one match at a time. Each win changes what they think of you and unlocks a scene. Sable, who founded the Afterglow, is watching.

mila.name: Mila Reyes
mila.tagline: Bike courier. Plays fast, talks faster. You towed her bike.
mila.grudge: You towed her bike on your first morning.
mila.signature_tip: A dead-straight rocket at the middle of your goal. Park your paddle in the centre of the mouth when you see the warning.
mila.perk_text: Win Mila over to learn her Bullet: your smash flies straight at the middle of her goal.

her_goal: Ha! Go back to your spreadsheet.
hostile.strip1: You did NOT just... fine. FINE. I'm still faster.
hostile.strip2: Stop staring and play, you creep!
hostile.strip3: This is not happening. This is NOT happening.

your_goal: Do that again. No, wait, don't.
warm.strip1: Heh. You've been waiting for that one, huh?
warm.strip2: Eyes on the puck. ...Or don't. Your call.
warm.strip3: Okay, you win this round. Mostly.

before.text: Twenty-eight bucks to get my bike out of the impound. I'm taking it out of your dignity.
I'll pay you back if you win.
Oh, I'm winning. And then you're writing that letter.

after.text: No. No way. Best of three!
League rules say one match a night.
Then I'll be back tomorrow. Don't you dare tow anything.

scene.title: Sore Loser
scene.brief: Mila sits on the edge of the table in whatever she has left, arms crossed, glaring at you and refusing to admit she's blushing.

before.text: I watched replays of myself all day. I lean left when I panic. Not tonight.
Also I wore an extra layer. Strategy.
That's... actually smart.
Don't compliment me. It's weird.

after.text: I leaned left. I leaned SO left.
...You're not totally awful. For a suit. Walk me to my bike? I'm not exactly dressed for the street.

scene.title: Borrowed Jacket
scene.brief: Outside under the neon sign, Mila wears your work jacket and nothing much under it, leaning on her bike, still pretending to be annoyed.

before.text: I told the other couriers about you. They want you towed.
I told them to back off. Only I get to beat you.

after.text: Okay, I give up being mad. It's exhausting.
Buy me fries. Big ones. We're friends now, apparently.

scene.title: Fries at 4 AM
scene.brief: Mila in her sports bra and your jacket, sharing fries with you on the lounge's back steps at dawn, leaning on your shoulder.

before.text: No jokes tonight. If I win, you buy breakfast for a week.
And if I win?
Then I stop pretending I keep coming back for the hockey.

after.text: Fine. You win. I like you. There, I said it.
Here, have my Bullet. I'll teach you the wrist thing. Later. The blinds are down and you owe me a different kind of rematch.

scene.title: After Hours
scene.brief: Mila's romance scene in the closed lounge. Adult scene: write to your content plan.

juno.name: Juno Hart
juno.tagline: Bartender. Never hits the puck straight. You took her job.
juno.grudge: You got the manager job she'd been doing for free.
juno.signature_tip: A wall shot that loses no speed on the bounce. Watch which wall she aims at and meet it on the rebound.
juno.perk_text: Win Juno over to learn her Ricochet: your smash banks off the far wall without losing speed.

hostile.strip1: It's a vest. I have plenty of dignity left.
hostile.strip2: If you say one word, I'm spitting in your drinks forever.
hostile.strip3: ...Congratulations. You're the worst person I know.

warm.strip1: Mm. That one I let you have.
warm.strip2: You're blushing more than I am. Focus.
warm.strip3: Well. Now we're even on staring.

before.text: Two years I ran this place. Inventory, payroll, the broken claw machine. Then they send a stranger with a lanyard.
I didn't ask for the job.
Then losing it shouldn't hurt. Straight shots are for people who can't do geometry.

after.text: You read the wall. Nobody reads the wall.
This changes nothing. You're still a lanyard.

scene.title: Behind the Bar
scene.brief: Juno, half out of her uniform, slams a drink down in front of you, furious, and refuses to admit she lost.

before.text: I've drawn every angle on this table on a napkin. Forty-one napkins.
Is that why we're out of napkins?
Don't. Be. Charming.

after.text: Forty-two napkins, and none of them had you on it.
...I read your memo. You never sent the order to shut us down. Why?
Because this place is the only thing that chain bought that's worth anything.

scene.title: The Memo
scene.brief: Juno in her slip on the office desk, reading your unsent memo by lamplight, looking up at you differently for the first time.

before.text: Proposal. You keep the title, I keep running the place, and we both lie to head office.
Deal. Winner picks who does payroll.

after.text: Fine, I'll do payroll. You'd mess it up anyway.
Stay for a nightcap. I'll make the one that isn't on the menu.

scene.title: Off the Menu
scene.brief: Juno sits on the bar in her underwear and your tie, sliding you a glowing cocktail with a small smile.

before.text: Last napkin. It just says: don't fall for the new guy.
So I'd better win, huh?

after.text: I'm keeping that napkin. Framing it, actually.
Here's my Ricochet. The trick is to aim at the wall like you mean it. Now lock the door. I want a long, slow angle on you.

scene.title: Perfect Angle
scene.brief: Juno's romance scene behind the bar. Adult scene: write to your content plan.

sable.name: Sable Marchetti
sable.tagline: Founded the Afterglow, sold it to your chain. Undefeated for six years.
sable.grudge: You're the face of the company that bought her lounge.
sable.signature_tip: Leaves wide and curls back into your goal. Don't chase where it starts; cover where it bends to.
sable.perk_text: Win Sable over to learn her Hook: your smash curls into the goal from a wide angle.
sable.unlock: Win over one of the regulars (beat all 4 of her matches)

her_goal: Is that all the company sent?
hostile.strip1: Nobody has seen me without this blazer in six years. Enjoy the view. Once.

warm.strip1: Go on. You've earned a look.
warm.strip2: My hands are shaking. Your fault.
warm.strip3: I don't lose. I just... let you have tonight.
warm.signature: Can you read the curve yet?

before.text: I built this place with my own hands. Sold it to keep the lights on. And they sent you to tidy up what's left.
My regulars like you now. I don't. Show me why I should.

after.text: Six years. Six years nobody has seen what's under this blazer.
Don't get comfortable. That was a warm-up.

scene.title: Under the Blazer
scene.brief: Sable leans back on the table, blazer gone, eyes narrowed, studying you like a problem she plans to destroy.

before.text: I closed early tonight. No audience.
Whatever happens on this table stays between us and the security camera I just unplugged.

after.text: ...My hands are shaking. That hasn't happened since my first tournament.
Juno told me about the memo you never sent. Come upstairs. We should talk.

scene.title: The Office
scene.brief: Sable in her old office in stockings and little else, lit pink by the neon sign through the window, pouring two drinks.

before.text: I've decided I'm buying the Afterglow back. With your help, my spy inside head office.
But I don't partner with people I can beat. Prove it again.

after.text: Partners, then. Fifty-fifty. I'll even let you keep the lanyard.
Partners celebrate. Stay.

scene.title: Partners
scene.brief: Sable in lingerie sits on the edge of her desk signing a napkin contract, pulling you in by your tie.

before.text: For the title. Winner's name goes at the top of the wall.
And me. Win or lose, honestly. But don't tell the others I said that.

after.text: New champion. Your name goes on the wall tomorrow.
And the Hook is yours. Tonight, though, you're mine. Champion's privilege works both ways.

scene.title: Champion's Privilege
scene.brief: Sable's romance scene on the lounge's championship table. Adult scene: write to your content plan.
